interpretation: Temperature can act on the same pigment network that recurrent natural white variants perturb, but the sign and strength of temperature effects are context dependent. Parrya provides the clearest natural same-species bridge between warmer environments, white frequency, and an anthocyanin-pathway regulatory mechanism.
model: genotype/pathway state × thermal environment -> pigment-network flux -> floral chromatic endpoint
hard_nonclaims: does not make BIO5 a replicated universal FCP driver
